text: Bitcoin's 2.3% gain outpacing Ethereum's 1.3% has pushed BTC dominance to 56.2%, signaling investors are rotating toward the perceived safer major asset amid extreme fear conditions. The Fear & Greed index at 22 reflects capitulation, yet steady 24-hour volume of $62B and modest gains across all major coins suggest this fear is attracting selective buying rather than panic liquidation. The seven-day improvement in sentiment combined with broad-based small gains indicates early stabilization after a sharp drawdown.
